description: Create (or update, idempotent by name — or pass agent_id to update that agent) a full agent in one call: persona/values/model tiers, granted brains, tool permissions, autonomy, and seed memory/skills/goals/todos. tenant/owner come from the caller. UPDATES ARE PARTIAL: fields you omit stay as they are (values, persona, description, models, autonomy); pass null to clear one. tool_permissions are added or changed, never removed. Schedule (only when given): trigger_mode, run_every_minutes, run_from/run_to (working window), run_days. Any invalid entry rejects the whole call before anything is written. Returns { agent_id, applied, now } — `now` is read back from the database (values_chars, tool_permissions_total), so check it.

agent_id.description: Existing agent to update. name is then optional.

deliberate_model.description: Model for slower, more careful reasoning steps of this agent

fast_model.description: Model for quick, routine steps of this agent

grund.description: Why this change (goes into the optimisation register, list_optimierungen)

persona.description: Persona text describing the agent's role and style

run_every_minutes.description: Run cadence in minutes for server_job agents, e.g. 1440 for daily

run_from.description: HH:MM start of the working window

run_to.description: HH:MM end of the working window

name: provision_agent
